question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (AMD)

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to ~$13.0B +/- $0.3B (consensus ~$13.06-13.08B). Over the last 8 quarters AMD beat its guidance midpoint by 1.8%-7.0% (median ~4%; Q2'26 +3.0% vs $11.2B guide, Q4'25 ~+7%, Q1'26 ~+4.6%). Applying that distribution gives a median ~ $13.45B. Data center momentum and analyst beat-and-raise calls (Stifel) support upside; tight server CPU supply and gaming decline cap it. No prediction market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold for AMD quarterly revenue. Escape below $12B or above $14.2B judged <~1% each, not declared.

calls.reasoning: AMD guided Q3 2026 to about $13.0B +/- $0.3B; consensus is about $13.06B. AMD finished above its guidance midpoint in 8 of the last 8 quarters, by 1.8%-7.0% (recent-6 mean about 4.9%; latest quarter +3.0%). Supply tightness in wafers, packaging and HBM, a sharp gaming decline, and an already steep 13% quarter-on-quarter step in the guide argue for a beat near the middle of the historical range, about 4%, giving a median near $13.5B. Late-October stock weakness concerns AI-spending sentiment, not this quarter, which has already closed. No prediction market was found by the runs (Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold); none of the runs reported checking bookmakers.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on every checkable fact: the Q3 guide ($13.0B +/- 0.3B), Q2 actual vs guide (+3.0%), the historical beats, consensus about $13.06B, the Nov 3 release date, and no market or pre-announcement found. Run 3 says its earlier guide figures came 'from memory' and Runs 1 and 2 cite no source for them, but all three runs' figures for the 6 overlapping quarters agree. With no web access on this run I could not re-check them. The median gap ($13.46B-$13.57B) is judgment: whether to count the smaller 2024 beats, and how much weight to give the latest +3% beat and the supply constraints. I chose a beat of about 4% (median about $13.51B). The upside escape (Run 3: 2%) needs a beat of more than 9%, which has no precedent in this record, so I declared no probability outside the range and kept the right tail wide inside it instead.
